Name: Leah Event Expansion - Cozy Time with Leah
Author: glacierpinecone
Description:
[left][b]Preface: [u]Please scroll down for the machine-translated English version.[/u][/b] My English is not good, so the introduction was machine translated after writing the Chinese version. There may be errors, please forgive me. The dialogues and events of this Mod are all in Chinese, then machine translated into English. If you want to translate them into more authentic English or other languages, I welcome it very much. [/left]
[center][size=5][b]简介[/b][/size]

[left]从莉亚说出“[i]如果你想要窝在我的被子里喝点苹果酒的话，就来我的小屋里坐坐吧[/i]”时，我就想做这个事件拓展了。单一个事件做的很快，但做完之后我又想，这个内容是不是太少了？所以，我继续做了下去。于是，一个包含 18 个子事件、文本量约 1w5 、含 3 张原创CG的可重复事件随之诞生了！
现在，你可以和莉亚一起喝热苹果酒、吃点心喝绿茶、翻阅艺术杂志，聊聊山谷生活、理想与未来、自然与艺术，总之，随自己的喜好和莉亚度过休闲的时光！当然，还有可选的恋爱向内容♥[/left]
[left]这不仅仅是“和莉亚喝苹果酒”的模组，而是让你有更多机会与她安静相处、深入交谈、共享温暖时光的故事扩展。
[center][b][size=5]内容说明[/size][/b][/center]
[/left]
[/center]
[b][size=4]1.莉亚前置剧情事件（6心）[/size][/b]
[spoiler]触发条件：冬天，10:00-22:00，和莉亚好感度6心，当莉亚在家时，在莉亚的农舍
在冬天来到莉亚的家，你可以和莉亚一起窝在被窝里，喝点苹果酒。
[b]如果已婚，莉亚不在家无法触发，可以选择打开content.json，删除第262行中的p Leah/，即可触发。若不想修改文件，可以在配置菜单中关闭“需要前置”和“需要莉亚在家”的选项，也可以正常触发后续的可重复事件。[/b][/spoiler]
[b][size=4]2.可重复触发的休闲事件[/size][/b]
[spoiler]默认触发条件：冬天（可修改），星期六（可修改），10:00-22:00（可修改），和莉亚好感度6心，当莉亚在家时（可修改），在莉亚的农舍
包含 18 个可选择的话题子事件。
三种与莉亚共度时光的方式：
[list]
[*]一起喝苹果酒，聊聊过去、未来和人生。[/*]
[*]一起吃点心，聊聊日常生活中的趣事。[/*]
[*]一起看艺术杂志，聊聊艺术与自然。[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
对于可重复事件，共有 3 种活动，每种活动默认包含 4 个普通话题。
恋爱内容独立可选，默认关闭。开启恋爱内容后，每种活动会额外增加 2 个更亲密的话题。
包含 3 张原创事件插画，可分别设置是否显示普通内容与恋爱内容的插画。

[size=4][b]3.配置选项[/b][/size]
可通过配置菜单调整以下内容：
[list]
[*]是否启用可重复事件。[/*]
[*]是否需要前置事件。[/*]
[*]可触发的季节、星期与时间段。[/*]
[*]是否要求莉亚在家。[/*]
[*]是否显示普通事件插画。[/*]
[*]是否启用恋爱内容。[/*]
[*]是否显示恋爱剧情插画。[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]4.前置模组[/size]
[/b]必备：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]ContentPatcher[/url]
推荐：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
[b][size=4]5.其它[/size][/b]
我个人精力有限，而且英文不是很好，所以这个mod的对话是用中文写然后机翻为英文的。如果有人能够把它翻译为更地道的英文或其它语言，我非常欢迎！（文本放置于i18n文件夹中）如果你进行了翻译，请联系我，我会在此备注以便使用！
本模组只添加新的莉亚事件，不会替换原版对话、日程、好感度机制。
模组支持已有存档，并设计为可与大多数剧情扩展模组共同使用。如遇到问题，请在反馈时附上 SMAPI 日志。感谢游玩！

[center][size=5][b]Introduction[/b][/size]

[left]The idea for this event expansion first came to me when Leah said, [i]“ Stop by my cabin if you want to huddle under one of my quilts and drink cider. ”[/i] I started working on it right away, and the initial event came together quickly—but once it was done, I thought, [i]is that really enough?[/i] So I kept going. What started as a small addition eventually grew into a repeatable event pack featuring [b]18 sub‑events,[/b] [b]roughly 10,000 words of dialogue, and 3 original CG illustrations![/b]
Now you can spend quality time with Leah—sipping hot apple cider, enjoying snacks and green tea, flipping through art magazines, and chatting about valley life, dreams, the future, nature, art—whatever strikes your fancy. Of course, there’s also [b]optional romantic content[/b] if you’d like to take things further ♥
This isn’t just a “drink apple cider with Leah” mod—it’s a story expansion that gives you more chances to quietly be together, have deeper conversations, and share warm, relaxing moments.[/left]
[/center]
[center][size=5][b]Details[/b][/size][/center]
[left][size=4][b]1.[/b][b]Pre‑requisite story event (6 hearts)[/b][/size][/left]
[spoiler][b]Trigger conditions:[/b] Winter, between 10:00 AM and 10:00 PM, [b]6 hearts[/b] of friendship with Leah, while she is at home, inside her farmhouse.
In winter, when you visit Leah’s cottage, you can join her under the covers with a glass of apple cider.
[b]If you are married with Leah and Leah is not at home, the event may not trigger. To work around this, you can open [/b]
[code]content.json[/code][b] and delete the substring [/b]
[code]p Leah/[/code][b] on line 262 – this will allow it to trigger.
If you'd rather not edit the file, you can also turn off both the [i]"Require Introductory Event"[/i] and [i]"Require Leah to Be Home"[/i] options in the config menu, and the subsequent repeatable events will still trigger normally.[/b][/spoiler]
[size=4][b]2. [/b][b]Repeatable events[/b][/size]
[spoiler][b]Default trigger conditions:[/b] Winter (configurable), Saturday (configurable), 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM (configurable), [b]6 hearts[/b] with Leah, while she is at home (configurable), inside her farmhouse.
A total of 18 topic‑based sub‑events, divided into three different ways to spend time with Leah:
[list]
[*]Drink cider together – talk about the past, the future, and life in general.[/*]
[*]Enjoy snacks together – chat about everyday little joys and funny moments.[/*]
[*]Browse art magazines together – discuss art, nature, and creativity.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
For repeatable events, each activity has [b]4 regular topics[/b] by default.
Romantic content is [b]optional and turned off by default[/b]. When enabled, each activity gains [b]2 extra, more intimate topics[/b].
The mod includes [b]3 original event illustrations[/b], and you can choose separately whether to show illustrations for regular content and for romantic content.

[size=4][b]3.[/b][b]Configuration Options[/b][/size]
Through the config menu (GMCM recommended), you can adjust:
[list]
[*]Whether repeatable events are enabled.[/*]
[*]Whether  Pre‑requisite story event is required.[/*]
[*]Which seasons, weekdays, and time slots they can trigger in.[/*]
[*]Whether Leah must be home.[/*]
[*]Whether to show regular event illustrations.[/*]
[*]Whether to enable romantic content.[/*]
[*]Whether to show romantic event illustrations.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]4. [/b][/size][b][size=4]Requirements[/size]
[size=3] Required: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]ContentPatcher
[/url] Recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM
[/url][/size][size=4]5.[b]Additional Notes[/b][/size][/b]
My personal energy is limited, and my English is not very good, so the dialogue for this mod is written in Chinese and then machine-translated into English. If anyone can translate it into more idiomatic English or other languages, I would greatly appreciate it! (The text is placed in the i18n folder.) If you have translated it, please contact me, and I will make a note here for future use!
This mod only adds new events for Leah—it does not replace her vanilla dialogue, schedule, or heart mechanics.
It works with existing saves and is designed to be compatible with most other story‑expansion mods. If you run into any issues, please include your SMAPI log when reporting them.
[b][size=4]Thank you for playing! Enjoy your time with Leah ♥[/size][/b]
